source_reference: UI-03, UI-10 and UI-16 recognition labels; executable SHA-256 4a1ea879e1079b81b1c501e7ef0c399cf7d0890c2b33fc79f97c412462036a3
fixture: Synthetic image containing high-contrast printed words and punctuation.
trigger: Invoke Instant Text/Recognize Text on the fixture.
target_observation_needed: Record recognized text, ordering, formatting and output destination.
ferby_observation_needed: Record OcrPanel recognition result and formatted output using the exported API.

limitations: The public index exports types and formatting helpers, not native OCR wiring or accuracy.

source_reference: UI-03, UI-10 and UI-16 Instant Text/QR affordances
fixture: Synthetic image containing a QR code with a known non-sensitive payload.
trigger: Invoke Recognize Text or QR on the QR fixture.
target_observation_needed: Record payload extraction, displayed preview and copy/output behavior.
ferby_observation_needed: Record Ferby recognition result, payload handling and output destination.
acceptance_rule: Pass only when the recorded Ferby payload and handling match the recorded target behavior.
limitations: No QR function or destination contract is exported by the named index.

source_reference: UI-12 primary OCR language and line-break settings
fixture: Synthetic multi-line image with explicit language options and wrapped lines.
trigger: Recognize with selected primary language and line-break removal variants.
target_observation_needed: Record available language choices and exact output line-break behavior.
ferby_observation_needed: Record DEFAULT_OCR_LANGUAGES, OcrRecognizeOptions handling and formatRecognizedOcrText output.
acceptance_rule: Compare language availability and normalized text only after target observations are captured.
limitations: The index exports option types and a formatter but does not establish persisted settings or native language support.

source_reference: UI-02 Open File; E-PLIST editable PNG/JPEG/GIF declarations
fixture: Synthetic PNG, JPEG and GIF files, including one unsupported or malformed file.
trigger: Use Open File for each encoding and the malformed boundary case.
